candidates.title: EIA expects record electricity generation in 2026 and 2027
candidates.summary: The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) expects U.S. electricity generation will grow 2.2% to a record 4,368 billion kilowatthours (BkWh) this year. EIA expects an additional 1.7% growth in electricity generation next year.

candidates.title: UN fact-finding mission on Iran focuses on plight of civilians
candidates.summary: The Independent International Fact-Finding Mission on Iran confirmed that civilians in the country suffered serious human rights violations and “crimes against humanity committed by their government,” while finding "reasonable grounds" to believe that the United States committed “war crimes” in the context of its ongoing conflict with the Islamic Republic.

candidates.title: AI, climate and conflicts top Guterres’s agenda ahead of General Assembly
candidates.summary: Ahead of the UN General Assembly’s high-level week, Secretary-General António Guterres said the world had entered “an era of deep uncertainty” and urged governments to embrace international cooperation to address global threats.

candidates.title: Escalating conflict drives new displacement in Yemen
candidates.summary: The escalating conflict in Yemen is choking off aid shipments and driving fresh displacement, including to nearby Djibouti, with UN agencies reporting on Tuesday that nearly 100,000 people have been displaced since fighting intensified earlier this month.

candidates.title: Civilians bear the brunt, with deadly US strikes in Iran and thousands displaced in Yemen
candidates.summary: Independent UN human rights investigators called for an immediate cessation of hostilities on Monday following a series of United States airstrikes on Iran in recent weeks that have killed civilians as tensions ripple through the region.
